basis: Frozen 92-territory constituency reference plus the already-frozen pre-election 2021 enriched candidate roster only; no target outcome or post-election information.
policy: EXACT_NORMALIZED rows pass with their collection territory_id unless district_source is an exact key in canonical_id_overrides. A non-exact row passes only when district_source is an exact key in accepted_aliases. Any other non-exact row fails closed, except the explicitly listed ambiguous source which is excluded from candidate evidence and therefore remains MISSING in the complete 92x9 panel.

Azilal-Bzou-Ouaouizart.reason: The source label conflates tokens from two distinct frozen 3-seat constituencies. No deterministic outcome-free bijection is established, so the six candidate-evidence rows are excluded rather than guessed.

missingness_rule: Excluded or absent candidate evidence never drops a territory-party cell and never creates a negative residual; its features remain explicit MISSING under the frozen information-set contract.
